wayback._eras_note: Five site generations on indexventures.com (CDX enumeration 2026-10-01, data/filings/index-ventures/cdx-enum.json, 60,000 URL keys, capped inside /startup-jobs): 1999-2002 static pages (/portfolio.html, /portf_sect.html, /portf_geo.html, one page per partner), 2002-2007 a CGI site (/cgi-local/ivw_port_detail.cgi?typ=it|ls&sec=&com=<name>), 2007-2013 a PHP site (/portfolio/index/industry_id/<1 IT|2 life sciences>/company_status/<current|exited|past>, /portfolio/index/company_id/<n>), 2014-2019 Drupal (/companies/a-z, /companies/<slug>, exits carry the acquirer or ticker in the slug), 2019-2026 Wagtail (/companies/<slug>/, read live through site_api). The archive eras are parsed by scratch/archive-listings.py into sources/wayback/parsed/<year>.json with capture_url per row; no era here is a wayback-pull.py parser, so this list stays empty and the parsed files are the record.

roster._note: The roster is the live team page (data-role investor) unioned with the archived people pages of every site era (1999-2002 one static page per partner, 2002-2007 /cgi-local/ivw_team_detail_*.cgi?nam=<name>, 2007-2013 /team pages, 2014-2026 /team/<slug>), curated per person with a dated basis in sources/wayback/partner-roster.json (scratch/roster-curate.py).

site_api._note: indexventures.com is Wagtail (Django). /companies/backed/all/ renders all 329 cards in one page, each with data-backed (select / seed / all-seed), data-regions, data-sectors and a ticker-or-acquirer span; sitemap-companies.xml lists the same 329 pages. A company page carries Founders/CEOs, Index Team, Sector, Website and the related Perspectives posts; it carries no investment year and no round word. The listing's own 'backed at Seed' filter is the one stage claim (decisions.md D8). scratch/site-scrape.py reads both; raw pages in data/filings/index-ventures/site-raw (gitignored). The Perspectives archive (1,238 posts in sitemap-perspectives.xml) is the news surface.
site_api._entry_stage_note: stage_site is the live listing's 'backed at Seed' filter (data-backed carries seed or all-seed on 75 of 329 cards): the firm's own claim about the round IT entered, so eligible by semantics; it says Seed and nothing else, and a card without it is no claim. Scored 2026-10-01 by scratch/label-score.py against this book's own cited entry rounds: 31 of 36 (the misses are auxmoney, cowboy-space, deliveroo, notion and revolut, plus pilot, whose first round the firm's own post calls a Series A). Promoted at MEDIUM; a row's own cited round wins where it disagrees. The 2009-2013 site's stage filter is NOT in this file list (it lives in sources/wayback/archive-facts.json): 'Seed stage' alone labels at LOW (1 of 1 cited, 7 rows), a company filed under both 'Seed stage' and 'Early stage' is an anchor (0 of 5), 'Early stage' straddles Seed and Series A (Facebook sits under it). decisions.md D8.

edgar._note: EDGAR company names 2026-10-01: 34 'Index Ventures ...' fund filers (Growth I-VII, III-XIII, Life VI and VII, the Parallel Entrepreneur Funds and three Delaware Entrepreneur Funds), 11 'Index Venture ... Associates' general partners (Index Venture Associates III-VII Ltd, Growth Associates I-V, Life Associates VI), three Index Origin funds. Adviser: Index Ventures SA, Geneva, exempt reporting adviser CRD 161175 / SEC 802-75760, ADV of 2026-03-31, Section 7.B.(1) 32 funds (sources/registers/adv-7b-funds.json). The bare word 'Index' is unusable as a phrase; 'Index Ventures' is entity-qualified. Medicxi (17 filers, own ERA CRD 283504) is a separate firm since 2016 (decisions.md D3).

desks._note: One firm under one adviser (Index Ventures SA, CRD 161175): venture funds I-XIII, Growth I-VII, Origin I-III, Life VI, the SPVs and the entrepreneur funds are all the home desk (decisions.md D1, D2). The base partitions by adviser, not by office or by the domicile of the portfolio company; the row's evidence regime is stated separately (decisions.md D9). Medicxi and Index Ventures Life VII (which became Medicxi Ventures I) are external (D3). Yucca (Jersey) SLP, Yucca Partners L.P. Jersey Branch and Yucca Associates Ltd administer the Index co-investment scheme and co-file with the funds (D2): home desk.

profile._note: Filled at profile time (focus crosswalk, focus_min_companies, site_office).
profile._focus_note: The site's own sector tags (310 of 560 rows carry one) mapped to the closed focus vocabulary; Mobility (8) and Talent (7) have no single counterpart and stay unmapped. The floor of 15 is about 5% of the tagged rows; it leaves out Healthcare (14) and Open Source (10).

hq_override.flaw: the site-list rule publishes the first office in page order, and the contact page orders the offices San Francisco, London, New York; page order is not a statement about where the firm operates, and it put the smaller office first.
hq_override.basis: The firm's own team page (https://www.indexventures.com/team) files 22 of its 49 people under London, against 14 under San Francisco and 10 under New York, among them 11 of its 26 investors; London is the firm's oldest operating office after Geneva ('Danny Rimer, who opened Index's London office in 2002', the firm's post of 2016-02-03). Ruled by Erik, 2026-10-06: 'make london HQ'.
